offer_letter.markdown:
# Offer of employment — Relationship Executive - Small Business (FAIS)

## 1. Our offer to you

Dear {{employee.full_name}}, we are pleased to offer you the job of Relationship Executive - Small Business (FAIS) at Absa Group. The job is permanent. You will start on 1 December 2026. Your place of work is Colesberg, head office.

## 2. What you will do

You will own the primary relationship with the client. You will be the client's main contact point for all corporate and investment banking needs. You will take overall accountability for service delivery by setting the rules of engagement for the cross functional team, which includes Transactional Banker, Credit Analyst, Segment Support Client Control Team, Client Service Consultant and Product & Sector teams. You will also take ownership of the portfolio's risk management by making sure you understand both the Bank's and the clients' regulatory and compliance environments. We may also ask you to do other reasonable duties that fit the position.

## 3. Pay and working hours

Your basic salary is R18,000.00 per month. We pay this monthly on the 25th by EFT. PAYE and UIF of 1% will be deducted. You will work 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day, over 5 days (Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00), with a meal break of 60 minutes. If you work agreed overtime, we pay 1.5 times your ordinary hourly wage.

## 4. Leave and probation

You get 15 working days of paid annual leave in each 12-month leave cycle. You get 30 days' paid sick leave in every 36-month cycle, and 3 days' family responsibility leave a year once you meet the conditions in the contract. Maternity leave is at least 4 consecutive months and parental leave is 10 consecutive days. Your first 3 months are a probation period, during which we will assess your performance and give you support.

## 5. How to accept

Please send us your ID and your qualifications. This offer is open until 30 November 2026. If you have questions, email hr@example.co.za.

## 6. Acceptance

I, {{employee.full_name}}, accept this offer on {{date_signed}}.

contract.markdown:
# Contract of employment — Relationship Executive - Small Business (FAIS)

## 1. Parties

This contract of employment is entered into between Absa Group, of 1 Main Road, Colesberg (the Employer), and {{employee.full_name}}, identity number {{employee.id_number}}, of {{employee.address}} (the Employee).

## 2. Position and duties

The Employer appoints the Employee as Relationship Executive - Small Business (FAIS). The Employee's duties include: Relationship Management: Own the primary relationship with the client by being the client’s main contact point for all corporate and investment banking needs.; Client Solutioning: Take overall accountability for service delivery by setting the rules of engagement for the cross functional team, which includes Transactional Banker, Credit Analyst, Segment Support Client Control Team, Client Service Consultant & Product & Sector teams.; Manager Risk Assessment: Take ownership of the portfolio's risk management by ensuring a good understanding of both the Bank's and the clients regulatory and compliance environments. The Employer may reasonably require the Employee to perform other duties consistent with the position.

## 3. Commencement

Employment commences on 1 December 2026 on a permanent basis.

## 4. Probation

The first 3 month(s) of employment are a probationary period during which the Employer will assess the Employee's performance against the requirements of the position and give reasonable evaluation, instruction, training, guidance or counselling where needed. Confirmation, extension or termination at the end of probation will follow a fair procedure.

## 5. Place of work

The Employee's place of work is Colesberg, head office.

## 6. Hours of work

The Employee's ordinary hours of work are 40 hours per week, 8 hours per day over 5 days per week (Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00). A meal interval of 60 minutes is taken after no more than five hours of continuous work. The Employee is entitled to a daily rest period of at least 12 consecutive hours and a weekly rest period of at least 36 consecutive hours.

## 7. Remuneration

The Employee will be paid R18,000.00 per month (basic salary), equivalent to R103.85 per ordinary hour, payable monthly on the 25th by EFT. No other cash payments are payable. No payments in kind are made.

## 8. Overtime

Overtime is worked only by agreement and may not exceed ten hours in any week. Overtime is paid at 1.5 times the Employee's ordinary hourly wage, or, by agreement, compensated with paid time off. Work on a Sunday is paid at double the ordinary wage (or one and a half times if the Employee ordinarily works on Sundays), and work on a public holiday at double the ordinary wage.

## 9. Deductions

The following deductions will be made from the Employee's remuneration: PAYE; UIF 1%. No other deduction will be made without the Employee's written agreement in respect of a specific debt, or as required by law, a court order or an arbitration award.

## 10. Leave

The Employee is entitled to 15 working days of paid annual leave per annual leave cycle of 12 months, to be taken at a time agreed with the Employer and not later than six months after the end of the cycle. Sick leave: 30 days' paid sick leave in every 36-month cycle (during the first six months, one day for every 26 days worked); a medical certificate may be required for absences of more than two consecutive days or on more than two occasions in eight weeks. Maternity leave: at least 4 consecutive months. Parental leave: 10 consecutive days. Adoption and commissioning parental leave as provided in the Act. Family responsibility leave: 3 days' paid leave per year once employed for longer than four months and for at least four days a week.

## 11. Termination and notice

Either party may terminate this contract on written notice of one week if the employee has been employed for six months or less; two weeks if employed for more than six months but not more than one year; four weeks if employed for more than one year. Notice may not be given during any period of leave. Nothing in this clause prevents the Employer from terminating employment summarily for a fair reason following a fair procedure, or the parties from agreeing to waive notice.

## 12. Bargaining council or sectoral determination

No bargaining council agreement or sectoral determination applies to the Employer's business.

## 13. Confidentiality

The Employee will not, during or after employment, disclose or use any confidential information of the Employer, its clients or suppliers, except as required to perform the Employee's duties or by law.

## 14. Other documents

No other documents form part of this contract.

## 15. General

This contract records the whole agreement between the parties on its subject; any amendment must be in writing and signed by both parties. Where any term is less favourable to the Employee than the Basic Conditions of Employment Act or an applicable sectoral determination or collective agreement, the more favourable provision applies. The Employer will keep these particulars for three years after termination and will explain them to the Employee on request.

## 16. Signatures

Signed at ____________ on {{date_signed}}.

For the Employer: {{employer.signatory}}  ____________________

The Employee: {{employee.full_name}}  ____________________

plain_language.explanation: This clause names the two sides of the contract. The employer is Absa Group at 1 Main Road, Colesberg. You are named with your identity number and your address.

You are appointed as Relationship Executive - Small Business (FAIS). Your duties are relationship management as the client's main contact for corporate and investment banking needs, client solutioning with overall accountability for service delivery and setting the rules of engagement for the cross functional team, and risk management of the portfolio. The employer may also ask you to do other reasonable duties that fit this position.
Your job starts on 1 December 2026. The contract is permanent, so it has no end date.

Your first 3 months are a probation period. During this time the employer checks your work against what the job needs, and must give you fair evaluation, instruction, training, guidance or counselling if you need it. At the end, your job can be confirmed, probation extended, or your employment ended, and a fair procedure must be followed.
You will work at Colesberg, head office. That is your place of work under this contract.

You work 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day, over 5 days, from Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00. You get a 60 minute meal break after no more than five hours of continuous work. You also get at least 12 hours of rest in a row each day and at least 36 hours of rest in a row each week.

You are paid a basic salary of R18,000.00 per month, which works out to R103.85 for each ordinary hour. The money is paid monthly on the 25th by EFT. There are no other cash payments and no payments in kind.

You only work overtime if you agree to it, and it cannot be more than ten hours in any week. Overtime is paid at 1.5 times your ordinary hourly wage, or you can agree to take paid time off instead. Sunday work is paid at double your ordinary wage, or one and a half times if you normally work Sundays, and public holiday work is paid at double.
The employer will take PAYE and UIF of 1% off your pay. No other deduction may be made unless you agree in writing for a specific debt, or the law, a court order or an arbitration award requires it.

You get 15 working days of paid annual leave for each 12-month leave cycle, taken at a time agreed with the employer and no later than six months after the cycle ends. You get 30 days' paid sick leave in every 36-month cycle, but in your first six months you get one day for every 26 days worked; a medical certificate may be asked for if you are off more than two days in a row or more than twice in eight weeks. Maternity leave is at least 4 consecutive months, parental leave is 10 consecutive days, adoption and commissioning parental leave follow the Act, and family responsibility leave is 3 paid days a year once you have worked longer than four months and at least four days a week.

Either you or the employer can end the contract with written notice: one week if you have worked six months or less, two weeks if more than six months but not more than one year, and four weeks if more than one year. Notice cannot be given while you are on leave. The employer may still dismiss you immediately for a fair reason using a fair procedure, and both sides can agree to skip notice.
No bargaining council agreement applies to the employer's business. No sectoral determination applies either.

You may not share or use confidential information of the employer, its clients or its suppliers. This applies while you work there and after you leave. The only exceptions are when you need it to do your job or when the law requires it.
No other documents form part of this contract. Only what is written in this contract counts.

This contract is the whole agreement on its subject, and any change must be written down and signed by both of you. If any term gives you less than the Basic Conditions of Employment Act, a sectoral determination or a collective agreement, the better provision applies. The employer keeps these particulars for three years after your employment ends and will explain them to you if you ask.
This is the signature block. It records the place and the date of signing. The employer's signatory signs for the employer, and you sign for yourself.
